title: @inth/angular: Angular cookie banner and cookie consent components
description: Cookie banner, consent dialog, and preference center for Angular. Standalone components, signals, zoneless change detection, and server rendering. Use the headless state and primitives when you want your own design.
features: Works with Angular 20, 21 and 22, zoneless or with zone.js
`provideC15t()` sets up consent once; `inject(ConsentManager)` reads it as signals anywhere
Server rendering with `@angular/platform-server`: the banner is in the first HTML
Headless directives for switches (with Angular forms), accordions, tabs, dialogs and preference items
`*c15tIfConsent` keeps content out of the DOM until the visitor agrees
prerequisites: An [Inth project](https://inth.com) (free sign-up), a [self-hosted backend](https://c15t.com/docs/self-host/quickstart), or local mode for development and tests
usage: Add `provideC15t()` to your application providers with a `mode`
Render `<c15t-consent-banner />` and `<c15t-consent-dialog />` once in your root component, and add `c15tConsentDialogLink` to a footer button

```html
<!-- Rendered only once the visitor allows marketing -->
<iframe *c15tIfConsent="'marketing'; else blocked" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/…"></iframe>
<ng-template #blocked>Allow marketing cookies to watch this video.</ng-template>
```
